note: Verified daily means as published by SEPA; o3/co are daily maximum 8-hour means. Station names were folded to keys by a fixed table; s146_id is set only where the name is one live station without doubt. Coverage is days with a value / days in the year; a mean at low coverage is not an annual mean in the legal sense. Live S146 rows start in 2026 and verified files end with the latest published year, so there is no day-by-day overlap yet: this layer is the PAST of each station (what is usual), not a check of today's numbers.
